nodes.description: StratManager state variable holding the keeper address used by the onlyManager modifier.
Address where strategist fee earnings are sent; also gates setStrategist.
Router address used as the target of all swap and addLiquidity external calls.
Parent vault address that gates withdraw and retireStrat.
Ownable private owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Fee applied on withdraw, used in arithmetic lpTokenBal * withdrawalFee / MAXFEE.
Strategist share of harvest profit, summed into totalFee.
Vault share of side profit, summed into totalFee.
Caller reward share of harvest profit, summed into totalFee.
MasterChef pool id used for all farm deposit/withdraw/userInfo calls.
IMasterChef farm contract instance that receives external interactions.
Intermediary token used in swap routes.
Reward token harvested and compounded by the strategy.
LP token staked into the MasterChef farm.
First underlying asset of the staked LP token.
Second underlying asset of the staked LP token.
Token used to pay call, strategist and vault fees.
Timestamp of the last harvest, written after external interactions complete.
setKeeper(address) external onlyManager; updates keeper address.
setStrategist(address) with require(msg.sender == strategist).
setUnirouter(address) external onlyOwner; updates the router target.
setVault(address) external onlyOwner; updates the parent vault.
withdraw(uint256) external; gates on vault, optionally uses tx.origin and transfers LP out.
harvest() external whenNotPaused onlyEOA; entrypoint of the compounding flow.
Internal harvest routine: beforeHarvest, chargeFees, addLiquidity, deposit, then state write.
Swaps reward for side profit token and pays call, strategist and vault fees.
Splits reward token, swaps halves and calls router addLiquidity.
retireStrat() external; emergency withdraws from farm and sends all LP to vault.
inCaseTokensGetStuck(address) external onlyManager; transfers arbitrary tokens to caller.
panic() public onlyManager; pauses and emergency withdraws from the farm.
unpause() external onlyManager; unpauses, restores allowances and re-deposits.
resetValues(...) public onlyOwner; reconfigures tokens, farm, pool id and routes.
farmDeposit(uint256) internal whenNotPaused; deposits LP into the masterchef farm.
farmWithdraw(uint256) internal override; withdraws LP from the masterchef farm.
balanceOfPool() public view; reads userInfo from the farm.
beforeHarvest() internal override; calls farm.deposit(poolId, 0) to sync rewards.
farmEmergencyWithdraw() internal override; calls farm.emergencyWithdraw.
giveAllowances() internal override; approves farm and router for MAX_INT.
removeAllowances() internal override; resets all approvals to zero.
deposit() public whenNotPaused; stakes idle LP balance into the farm.
setWithdrawalFee(uint256) external onlyManager with MAXFEE bound.
setStratFee(uint256) external onlyManager with MAXFEE bound.
setProfitFees(uint256) external onlyManager with MAXFEE bound.
setCallFee(uint256) external onlyManager with MAXFEE bound.
owner() public view returns the current owner; used by onlyManager.
transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner; transfers contract ownership.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner; sets owner to zero address.
msg.sender used in access checks, fee payment and rescue transfers.
block.timestamp used as swap/addLiquidity deadline and as lastHarvest value.
tx.origin used in withdraw to waive the withdrawal fee and in onlyEOA.
External router call swapExactTokensForTokens with zero min-out and block.timestamp deadline.
External router call addLiquidity with minimum amounts of 1 and block.timestamp deadline.
SafeERC20 token transfer to vault, msg.sender or strategist, an external call point.
External call farm.withdraw(poolId, amount).
External call farm.deposit(poolId, amount).
External call farm.emergencyWithdraw(poolId).
SafeERC20 approve of farm and router for MAX_INT / zero.
_amount parameter of withdraw(uint256).
_fee parameter of setWithdrawalFee(uint256).
lpTokenBal local in withdraw tracking current LP balance.
withdrawalFeeAmount local computed as lpTokenBal * withdrawalFee / MAXFEE.
totalFee local = strategistFee + sideProfitFee + callFee.
toProfit local = mulDiv(rewardToken balance, totalFee, MAXFEE).
rewardTokenHalf local = reward token balance / 2.
lp0Bal local = lpAsset0 balance held by the strategy.
lp1Bal local = lpAsset1 balance held by the strategy.
sideProfitBalance local = sideProfitToken balance after the swap.
_poolId parameter of resetValues(...).
_farmAddr parameter of resetValues(...) passed to setFarmAddress.
newAddr parameter of setFarmAddress(address).
_token parameter of inCaseTokensGetStuck(address).

edges.reason: withdraw gates execution on require(msg.sender == vault).
harvest is restricted by the onlyEOA modifier comparing msg.sender to tx.origin.
withdraw compares tx.origin to owner() to decide whether the withdrawal fee is charged.
onlyManager authorizes setKeeper using msg.sender against owner() and keeper.
setStrategist requires msg.sender == strategist.
inCaseTokensGetStuck is guarded by onlyManager and pays msg.sender.
retireStrat requires msg.sender == vault before moving all funds.
resetValues is guarded by onlyOwner and rewrites critical addresses.
vault state variable is the authorization reference for withdraw.
strategist state variable is compared with msg.sender in setStrategist.
_owner drives the onlyOwner check of setUnirouter.
_owner drives the onlyOwner check of setVault.
farm instance is the target of farmWithdraw.
poolId is passed as the first argument of farm.withdraw.
withdraw _amount is forwarded to the farm withdrawal.
poolId is used in the farm.userInfo query.
poolId is passed to farm.deposit.
unirouter state variable is the call target of swapExactTokensForTokens.
unirouter state variable is the call target of addLiquidity.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidity deadline.
lastHarvest is assigned block.timestamp at the end of the harvest flow.
chargeFees performs an external router swap before completing fee accounting.
chargeFees transfers side profit tokens to msg.sender, strategist and vault.
addLiquidity performs an external router addLiquidity call.
addLiquidity swaps reward token halves through the external router.
harvest invokes chargeFees, introducing external calls before state finalization.
harvest invokes addLiquidity with further external router calls.
harvest re-deposits into the farm after external interactions.
lastHarvest is written only after all external calls complete.
harvest delegates the whole compounding flow to _harvestInternal.
withdraw pulls LP from the farm before transferring to the vault.
withdraw transfers LP tokens to the vault after external farm interaction.
deposit calls farmDeposit which performs the external staking call.
farmDeposit executes the external masterchef deposit call.
farmWithdraw executes the external masterchef withdraw call.
farmEmergencyWithdraw executes the external emergencyWithdraw call.
giveAllowances issues token approvals to the farm and router.
removeAllowances revokes token approvals from the farm and router.
withdrawalFee participates in the fee arithmetic that determines the transferred amount.
strategistFee is summed into totalFee used in mulDiv share arithmetic.
sideProfitFee is summed into totalFee used in mulDiv share arithmetic.
callFee is summed into totalFee used in mulDiv share arithmetic.
setWithdrawalFee accepts the _fee parameter that is bounded by MAXFEE.
unpause restores allowances and calls deposit.
resetValues calls removeAllowances before reconfiguring addresses.
resetValues calls giveAllowances after reconfiguring addresses.
panic pauses the strategy and triggers the emergency farm withdrawal.
_poolId parameter is stored into poolId inside resetValues.
_farmAddr parameter is used by resetValues via setFarmAddress.
_token parameter selects the token transferred by inCaseTokensGetStuck.
_fee parameter is written into the withdrawalFee state variable.
withdraw _amount is compared against the lpTokenBal local.
lpTokenBal local is used to compute withdrawalFeeAmount.
totalFee local is computed and required to be below 1000 inside chargeFees.
toProfit local is passed as the swap input amount.
rewardTokenHalf local is swapped into LP asset tokens.
sideProfitBalance local is split among the call, strategist and vault transfers.
